component.name: OxyPixel
component.summary: Draw pixel art and short animations

description.p: OxyPixel is a pixel-art editor for sprites and short animations. Draw on a pixel canvas with layers, groups, blend modes, and tilemaps, step through named frames and animation tags, and export PNG, GIF, or spritesheets with JSON, Godot, or Unity files.
It opens Aseprite files, packs sprite atlases with OxyPack, and includes an MCP server so AI assistants can draw and export with the editor's own tools.
